scope: Only branches with completed GitHub compare_commits evidence; not a whole-owner decision register

decision_rules.KEEP: Canonical main or exact duplicate head; do not delete without reference review.
decision_rules.DEVELOP: Ahead or diverged from main; inspect work and dependencies.
decision_rules.ARCHIVE_CANDIDATE: Behind with zero unique commits; candidate only, pending PR/tag/deployment/reference audit.
decision_rules.MERGE_READY: Requires open non-draft PR, no conflicts, exact-head successful CI with test/build steps, dependency closure, and review approval.
